title: Central Library
description: A vast collection of over 25,000 books, journals, and digital resources to support academic research and learning.
detailedDescription: The Central Library is the heart of academic life at SJMSM. It offers an expansive, air-conditioned reading hall capable of accommodating over 200 students. In addition to the massive collection of reference books and periodicals, students have access to a digital section with internet-enabled workstations for e-learning and research.

title: Computer Lab
description: State-of-the-art computer lab with high-speed internet and the latest software for practical learning.
detailedDescription: Equipped with over 60 high-performance workstations, our Computer Lab provides a hands-on technical environment. Students can utilize the latest programming software, design tools, and an uninterrupted 100Mbps fiber-optic internet connection. The lab is open extended hours to assist students in completing their projects and research.

title: Sports Complex
description: Large playground and indoor sports facilities promoting physical fitness and team spirit.
detailedDescription: We believe in the holistic development of our students. The sports complex features a full-sized cricket/football ground, a volleyball court, and an indoor stadium for badminton and table tennis. Regular intra-college and university-level tournaments are hosted here, fostering sportsmanship and physical well-being.

title: College Canteen
description: Hygienic and affordable meals and snacks available for students and staff.
detailedDescription: The college canteen is a vibrant hub of student activity and relaxation. It offers a wide variety of hygienic, nutritious, and affordable meals, snacks, and beverages. The seating area is spacious and regularly sanitized, providing a comfortable environment for students to interact and unwind between classes.

title: Seminar Hall
description: Equipped with audio-visual aids for guest lectures, workshops, and cultural events.
detailedDescription: Our modern Seminar Hall has a seating capacity of 300 and is fully air-conditioned. It is equipped with advanced audio-visual equipment, including HD projectors and a premium sound system. It serves as the primary venue for guest lectures, academic workshops, cultural events, and college ceremonies.
